rows.what_the_ink_shows: The last three lines of Remarque 5.4, above the Bibliographie, read «pour tout X de type fini sur K, l’action de I est … ess^t unipotente d’échelon 3 (et = d’échelon 2 … si X est normal)». The first numeral has the two right-facing curves of 3; the second is a dark but recognizable 2, and the normality condition continues on the next line. The word «quasi» before ess^t is struck through. See crops/34_scan082_L625_levels_3_and_2.png.
rows.note: The original transcription already preserves the written distinction: «ess$^{\mathrm t}$ unipotente d’échelon 3 (et $=$ d’échelon 2 \deleted{\unsure{si}} si $X$ est normal)». Keep the 3 and conditional 2 exactly. The packet proposes the stronger bound 2 for every X of finite type and describes 3 as true but not sharp; this is a mathematical refinement, not a demonstrated transcription error or an instruction to modernize the manuscript. This run verifies the ink only and does not independently establish the stated sharpening or its cited printed source.
